survalis: Interpretable Survival Machine Learning

Source: R/survalis-package.R
survalis-package.Rd

survalis provides a unified interface for fitting, predicting, evaluating, tuning, comparing, interpreting and standardising survival machine-learning models across 24 learners.

The seven verbs

The recommended interface, consistent with the funcml package:

fit()

fit a learner by id, returning a survalis_fit.

predict()

typed predictions on a recorded time grid ("survival", "risk", "chf", "hazard", "rmst", "quantile", "median").

evaluate()

resampled performance for a fit or a formula.

tune()

grid search, returning the refit best model.

compare()

paired multi-model leaderboard on shared folds.

interpret()

one entry point to the explanation methods.

estimate()

standardised binary-treatment contrast by G-computation.

Resampling is described by cv(), holdout(), group_cv() and bootstrap(). Discover components with list_survlearners(), list_metrics() and list_interpretability_methods(). Custom learners plug into every verb as model = list(fit = , predict = ); see fit().
